measurement_method: Measured Q1-Q5 for open pipe resonators of a stated 100 Hz fundamental; per-mode frequencies not printed
note: REFERENCE ONLY. Q rises with mode number (radiation damping dominates at low frequency). Deriving mode frequencies as n*100 Hz would be an assumption, not a measurement, so the frequencies are null.
